description: This file defines API endpoints for managing and retrieving highlights in a sports live streaming platform. It uses FastAPI to create routes that fetch highlights list, details of a specific highlight, and latest featured highlights from the database via repository classes.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI routing class used to define API endpoints

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Repository class for database operations related to highlights

methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of highlights, optionally filtered by match ID
